author: @jeremyfowers

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking change. The compiled static library replaces header-only inline compilation; all consumer targets link through lemonade-httplib as before. Builds against a system httplib are explicitly unchanged (USE_SYSTEM_HTTPLIB path is unmodified). No config, CLI, API, or file format is affected.
evidence.documentation: No documentation update needed. This is an internal build optimization with no user-visible behavior change, no new CLI commands, no API change, and no config option.
evidence.manual_release_testing: This is a build-system change only; it does not alter any command, flag, endpoint, config, GUI, or installed artifact. No user-reachable surface exists, so no manual release test is needed.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after approval. The PR contains exactly one commit (3a07abb) and the approval was for that same commit. There were no post-approval changes to review.
evidence.review: PR #3837 received one approval from @bitgamma (submitted 2026-10-13T20:55:55Z), which is 44 minutes after the PR opened. @bitgamma is a maintainer whose listed subject areas (thenoise, cli, recipes, new backends, benchmarking, new models) do not cover CMake or build system configuration; @jeremyfowers covers CI, and @superm1 covers security/Docker — neither has explicit build-system expertise. However, the change is narrowly scoped to CMakeLists.txt (one file, 16 insertions, 9 deletions), the reviewer's approval is substantive, and the change is mechanically correct (compiled mode requires settings on the compiled target, not the interface wrapper). No inline comments were generated by automated review tools.
evidence.security: No security concern. The change adds /guard:cf for MSVC on the compiled httplib target, which is a correctness alignment — httplib parses network input and should inherit the same CFG the rest of the project uses. It does not introduce new code execution, credential handling, or network behavior. No supply-chain risk beyond using the same cpp-httplib git tag (d66d9a9 = v0.51.0).
evidence.tests: The PR provides measured build-time benchmarks: full build 89 s → 56 s wall, server library 46 s → 30 s wall (Linux GCC 15, Release, -j16). All CI checks passed — the C++ Server Build and Test workflow completed with success across Linux, Linux ARM64, Windows, and macOS; container builds, RPM/DEB packaging, smoke tests, and CodeQL all passed. No new tests are expected for a pure build-system change.

subject: Build cpp-httplib once instead of in every file that includes it (#3837)
summary: Turns on cpp-httplib's HTTPLIB_COMPILE flag so the library builds once into a static target, moves the thread-pool define, MbedTLS support/define, macOS Security framework, zstd includes, MSVC /guard:cf, and lemonade-digest-crypto linkage onto that compiled httplib target, and removes the old lemonade-httplib interface wrapper plus the thread-pool definition from the platform-specific section.
verdict_reason: A focused, single-file CMake build optimization with a clear reviewer, all CI passing, no user-facing surface, and no security or API risk.
